title: Mob Excavation
description: This mod allows you to kill groups of identical mobs with a single blow. Hold down the ~ (tilde) key (this can be changed in the control settings) and hit any mob – all mobs of the same type within a 2-block radius will receive the same damage.
body:
This mod allows you to kill groups of identical mobs with a single blow. Hold down the ~ (tilde) key (this can be changed in the control settings) and hit any mob – all mobs of the same type within a 2-block radius will receive the same damage.
   Tool durability and hunger are consumed proportionally to the number of mobs. Ideal for clearing mob farms or fighting hordes of zombies.
   Configurable via the config file: search radius, maximum number of mobs, durability and hunger consumption, mob blacklist. (mobexcavation-client.toml)
